jobs.description:

Established in 2002, MCA Connect has grown into one of the largest US-based solution partners in Microsoft Business Applications and Azure Data & AI / Digital & App Innovation. Our Microsoft Specialties include Finance and Supply Chain, Analytics on Azure, Data Warehouse Migration, and Power Platform. We’re also a fifteen-time Microsoft Partner of the Year and three-time Inc. Best Workplaces award winner.

Senior D365 Project Manager

Remote with US travel up to 50%

The MCA Connect Senior Project Manager is responsible for directing the implementation of one or more large-scale Dynamics 365 implementation projects. The typical project size and complexity is a 3-16-month duration involving up to 5-10 multi-disciplined implementation team members across one or more client locations.

You will be supported by a strong project team of solution architects, developers, and technical consultants but will need a strong background in project management and business process optimization and to have or develop a solid working knowledge with the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform. Our projects are major strategic investments for our clients and their successful execution requires a project manager that is driven, proactive, creative, and assertive.

While your primary function will be as a project manager, from time to time, we may also ask you to assist with other functions including sales and marketing, implementation-related tasks, and general administration related activities. This is a full-time salaried position with bonus.

Responsibilities

Manage one or more high risk, high complexity ERP and/or CRM projects

Work closely with MCA Connect resource management to ensure adequate allocation of resources to projects
Develops and manages detailed project plans, cost estimates, resource plans, communication plans, risk mitigation plans and issue resolution plans
Drive project decisions and recommendations to management about schedules, prioritization, and resource allocation

Proactively communicates and reports status to executives, MCA Connect management and all other stakeholders by leveraging tools such as status reports, executive briefings, and active day to day team communication

Employs project management leading practices as provided by PMI and MCA Connect delivery standards

Directly responsible for managing the project budget, and providing the predictive financial analysis required to deliver accurate project status

7+ years of experience directly managing software implementation deployments (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (ERP) and/or CE/CRM a plus)

Ability to allocate the correct resources to each project phase and monitor their performance
Consensus driven management style that support a vast set of stakeholders
Strong leadership, teambuilding and motivational skills

Ability to travel up to 50% of the time

jobs.title: D365 Project Manager, Managed Services
jobs.description:
Location
Virtual, home based office with travel

Description

The MCA Connect Project Manager in this role carries a blended portfolio. You will manage day to day support for live Dynamics 365 clients under Managed Services (MgS), manage the discrete enhancement and new functionality work those same clients buy, and direct one or more full life-cycle Dynamics 365 implementations from diagnosis through go-live and transition into support.

These three types of work are genuinely different disciplines.

MgS live support is a queue to be managed against service commitments
New functionality and enhancement work is a series of small, fixed-scope projects that must be estimated, scheduled and billed without disturbing the support commitment
A full life-cycle implementation is a large, multi-phase program with its own team, budget and executive visibility

The person in this role must be able to manage all three at once, switch cleanly between them, and protect each from the others.

You will be supported by a strong delivery team of solution architects, functional and technical consultants, and developers, but you will need a strong background in project management and business process optimization, and either a solid working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform or the capacity to build one quickly. Our projects are strategic investments for our clients. Their successful execution and their ongoing support both require a project manager who is driven, proactive, creative, assertive and relationship oriented.

While your primary function is project management, from time to time you may also be asked to assist with other functions including sales and marketing, implementation-related tasks, and general administration.

Responsibilities

The responsibilities below are grouped into the disciplines common to every engagement, then the three work streams in turn, then the financial, communication and practice duties that run across all of them. Each group opens with what the work is and why it matters, followed by the specific tasks the role owns.

Core project management, all work streams

A set of project management disciplines applies to every engagement you carry, whatever its size or commercial shape.

Manage multiple concurrent client engagements, and own deliverables, scope and expectations on each of them
Provide leadership to all functional and business areas affected by the work
Develop and maintain project plans, cost estimates, resource plans, communication plans, risk mitigation plans and issue resolution plans
Drive project decisions and make recommendations to management about schedules, prioritization and resource allocation
Work with MCA Connect resource management to secure resources, and resolve the challenges between support needs, enhancement commitments and other milestones
Employ project management leading practices as provided by PMI and MCA Connect delivery standards
Drive client satisfaction across the portfolio and own the health relationship of every account you carry

MgS live support clients

For an assigned portfolio of live Dynamics 365 clients, the work is a managed queue rather than a plan: tickets arrive on their own schedule to a support queue, and your job is to see that they are triaged correctly, worked by the right consultant, resolved inside the contracted commitment, and visible to the client throughout. Alongside the queue you monitor consumption against contract in period and raise the conversation about overage or change before the period closes rather than after.

Own the service relationship for each assigned live client and act as their main point of accountability
Manage the client’s service desk tickets: triage, prioritization, assignment, aging, escalation and closure
Balance case load across the available consultant pool and keep the queue from concentrating on one person
Run regular service reviews covering ticket volumes and trends, consumption against the retainer or hours block, open risks and the forward plan
Manage environment optimization and management activities, including release and update readiness for Microsoft's service update cadence, environment refreshes and performance reviews
Monitor consumption against contract in period and flag over-consumption and under-consumption early
Drive the conversation about overage, carry-over or contract change before the period closes
Convert recurring incidents and chronic pain points into problem records, root cause work or scoped enhancement proposals
Maintain accurate case records, time capture and status in Symphony so reporting, invoicing and utilization figures reconcile without manual correction
Receive projects transitioning in from the implementation team and confirm documentation, environments, known issues and open items all transferred

New functionality and enhancement delivery

Live clients regularly buy work that is not support. Further work could be a customization, implement a new D365 module, an integration change, a business process review, or a training package. Each of these is a small project in its own right. The recurring tension in this stream is resource: enhancement work and the support queue draw on the same consultants, and you are expected to schedule around that rather than let one quietly starve the other.

Qualify incoming requests, distinguish enhancements from support incidents, and route each to the right resources
Coordinate estimation with solution architects and consultants, and produce the scope, effort, schedule and price the client will approve
Secure written client approval of scope, cost and schedule before work begins
Schedule enhancement work packages against the same resource pool that carries the support queue, and protect the support commitment when the two compete
Manage each enhancement through design confirmation, build, test, client acceptance, deployment and post-deployment care
Coordinate deployment windows, regression testing and release notes with the client
Confirm enhancement releases align with Microsoft platform updates
Confirm each enhancement is documented and handed into the support model at completion

Full life-cycle Dynamics implementation projects

You will direct one or more end-to-end Dynamics 365 implementations, typically 3 to 16 months long with 5 to 10 multi-disciplined team members across one or more client locations. These are major strategic investments for our clients and carry executive visibility on both sides, so the role is a directive one: you own the integrated plan and the critical path, you chair the steering committee, and you are expected to drive decisions rather than report on them. A large share of the risk sits outside your own team, in client-side decisions, data readiness, integration counterparties and testing capacity, and managing those dependencies is part of the job rather than an excuse when they slip. The project is not finished at go-live; it is finished when it is running in support with the knowledge transferred.

Direct the implementation across all phases: Diagnosis, Analysis, Design, Development, Deployment and Operation and various Business Process Areas
Own the integrated project plan, the critical path, and the milestone and deliverable schedule
Manage scope formally through change control, including the financial and schedule consequence of every approved change
Coordinate the client-side workstreams the project which depends on: business process decisions, data readiness and cleansing, integration counterparties, testing resource, training and organizational change
Drive go-live planning and cutover activities, including cutover rehearsal, go and no-go criteria, contingency and rollback, and hypercare staffing
Produce the executive-level for client Steering Committee meetings
Transition the completed implementation into MgS with the support model, documentation, environment inventory, open defect list and knowledge transfer all in place

Qualifications

We are looking for a project manager who has run both project work and ongoing service delivery, because the blend is what makes this role difficult. Depth in Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a strong advantage. The non-negotiable is the ability to hold several clients at once without losing control of any of them.

4 or more years of experience directly managing software implementation deployments. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (ERP) or Customer Engagement (CRM) is a strong plus
Demonstrated experience managing both project-based delivery and ongoing support or managed services delivery, ideally at the same time
Experience with IT implementation methodologies across all phases of Diagnosis, Analysis, Design, Development, Deployment and Operation
Understanding industry standard Business Process Areas is a plus
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities across multiple concurrent clients
Good planning, organizational and problem-solving skills
Strong business acumen, including comfort with budgets, forecasts, and contract terms
Ability to work closely with key business stakeholders to communicate progress and vision
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to allocate the correct resources to each project phase and monitor their performance
Strong leadership, teambuilding and motivational skills
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
Ability to travel up to 50 percent of the time

Desired Qualifications

One or more full life-cycle Microsoft Dynamics implementations delivered end to end
Experience with the wider Microsoft platform of technologies
ERP implementation lead experience in the manufacturing industry
Experience with service management practice, including ITIL-aligned incident, problem and change management
PMI certification
Microsoft certification on the Dynamics 365 platform
Mastery of industry-standard project management tools

jobs.title: Program Manager - Indigenous Ranger Biodiversity Data Infrastructure Program (Identified Role)
jobs.description:
Acknowledgement of Country

CSIRO acknowledges the Traditional Owners of the land, sea and waters, of the area that we live and work on across Australia. We acknowledge their continuing connection to their culture and pay our respects to their Elders past and present. View our vision towards reconciliation .

Role highlights

Build and lead a nationally significant Indigenous biodiversity data program from the ground up.
Partner with Indigenous ranger groups and communities to create meaningful, lasting impact.
Shape the future of Indigenous-led biodiversity data, digital capability and research infrastructure.

About CSIRO

As Australia's national science agency, CSIRO is solving the greatest challenges through innovative science and technology. Many of our iconic innovations were once considered impossible until someone, just like you, joined us and took on the challenge.

Visit CSIRO.au for more information.

The opportunity

Join CSIRO’s Atlas of Living Australia (ALA) to establish and lead a new national program strengthening the digital capabilities of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander rangers and Knowledge Holders. Working across CSIRO, Curtin University, Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network (TERN), government and Indigenous communities, you will shape the program from the ground up and oversee initiatives that improve how ranger-collected biodiversity data is managed, accessed and shared.

This role combines strong relationship-building with disciplined program management. You will bring people together across a national network of partners while establishing clear plans, governance, deliverables, reporting and accountability. Working closely with the Program Coordinator, you will support culturally appropriate, community-led co-design and ensure Indigenous Data Sovereignty, CARE principles and cultural protocols are embedded throughout the program.

This is an opportunity to build a new national program with lasting impact, strengthening Indigenous leadership, ranger capability, digital infrastructure and community authority within Australia’s biodiversity research infrastructure.

Your high-level duties will include:

Leading program planning, governance and delivery to ensure all program outputs, milestones, budgets, and performance measures are achieved in accordance with NCRIS funding requirements and agreed project plans.
Managing stakeholder and partner relationships across CSIRO, ALA, TERN, Curtin University, government agencies, Indigenous ranger groups, and other participating organisations to support effective collaboration and program outcomes.
Supporting the Program Coordinator to design community engagement and co-design activities with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities to ensure program activities are culturally appropriate, community-led, and aligned with Indigenous Data Sovereignty and CARE principles.
Overseeing the delivery of digital infrastructure enhancements, including platform upgrades, data management capabilities, mapping tools, and biodiversity data services, to improve the accessibility and usability of Indigenous ranger-collected data.
Monitoring program finances, risks, issues, and dependencies, implement mitigation strategies, and provide regular reporting to governance bodies, funding agencies, and senior management.
Working with the Program Coordinator to design and carry out training, capability-building and knowledge-sharing initiatives that strengthen the skills of Indigenous rangers and improve participation in national biodiversity and research infrastructure systems.

Role particulars

Location and office arrangements:
Perth (Boorloo), WA or Canberra (Ngunnawal), ACT preferred; other locations may be considered on a case-by-case basis; hybrid working options available.

Salary:
AU$135k – AU$158k per annum (pro rata for part-time), plus 15.4% superannuation

Tenure & work schedule:
Specified term until 30 June 2029; Full time preferred; Options for part-time and flexible work arrangements can be discussed based on needs of role and individual circumstances.

Reference:
104306

As the successful candidate, you will bring:

Demonstrated cultural capability grounded in lived experience as an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person, with the ability to work respectfully across diverse Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander cultural contexts, communities and knowledge systems.
Strong Indigenous community connection and credibility along with cultural authority as an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
Tertiary qualifications in Science, Biodiversity or Environmental Science, Natural Resource Management or other relevant field / or equivalent experience. Experience working with Indigenous stakeholders, in the context of biodiversity monitoring, natural resources management, or biodiversity information
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence, engage and build support among diverse stakeholders, including senior leaders, partners, community representatives and government agencies.
Demonstrated experience managing programs or projects across complex, multi-stakeholder and multi-organisational environments, including planning, coordination, delivery, monitoring and reporting on outcomes.
Demonstrated understanding of Indigenous Data Sovereignty and Indigenous Data Governance, including the CARE Principles and Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property (ICIP), and experience supporting community authority and decision-making regarding the collection, management, access, use and sharing of Indigenous knowledge and data.

For full details about this role, and other criteria, please review the Position Description .

Setting you up for success

We are committed to providing a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and accessible to everyone. We recognise that it may be helpful for us to adjust our process to make it equitable for your individual situation. Please contact Cristina O’Brien via email at cristina.obrien@csiro.au and let us know how we can support you.

Life at CSIRO and flexible work arrangements

W e work flexibly at CSIRO , offering a range of options for how, when and where you work. We can discuss flexible work arrangements with you during the recruitment process. CSIRO also offers a range of leave entitlements, benefits and career development opportunities. To find out more, visit Careers at CSIRO .

Inclusion and belonging

Solving Australia's greatest challenges takes a diversity of minds and lived experiences. We know diverse teams are more effective and deliver more innovative outcomes. As an equal employment opportunity organisation, we are committed to creating diverse and inclusive teams where people feel they belong. We recognise true diversity encompasses all ages, abilities, cultures, faiths, levels of education, genders, sexualities, diversity of thought and much more. We focus on hiring people who share our values of People First, Further Together, Making it Real and Trusted.

CSIRO holds Gold Status for the Australian Workplace Equality Index for LGBTQIA+ inclusion, and a Science in Australia Gender Equity Bronze Award.

Eligibility

CSIRO considers the filling of this position is intended to constitute a special/equal opportunity/affirmative measure under section 8(1) of the Racial Discrimination Act 1975 (Cth) . The position is therefore only open to Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people with Australian Citizenship.

The successful applicant will be required to provide evidence to confirm that they are an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.

The successful candidate will be required to provide contact details of at least one Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander Cultural Referee to confirm their ability to work and communicate respectfully with Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander peoples.

Appointment to this role is subject to provision of a national police check and may be subject to other security/medical/character requirements.

Child safety

CSIRO is committed to the safety and wellbeing of all children and young people involved in our activities and programs. View our Child Safe Policy .

Please apply online and submit a cover letter (maximum 2 pages) and CV that demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the essential requirements of this role.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager – CRM Transformation
jobs.location: City Of London, England, United Kingdom
jobs.description:
Associate Project Manager - CRM Transformation - London

About us and why this role exists

The Fiser Group is a family of five talent and consulting businesses: Bruin (financial and professional services recruitment), Socium (Teams as a Service), IBAM (change management and FS consulting), Aquila (RPO and talent acquisition outsourcing) and Detillens (hire, train and deploy tech talent). We're headquartered in London and growing.

We're moving the whole Group onto a new CRM platform. The technology is the easy part. The real job is helping recruiters, consultants and leaders change how they work, and making sure they come out the other side with better tools and better processes.
Our teams are busy running the business day to day, so we're hiring someone whose sole focus is getting this right. You'll own the project end to end, reporting directly to the Board.

What you'll do

Run the project

Own the plan, timeline, budget, risks and issues for the CRM migration from kick-off to go-live and beyond
Be the day-to-day lead for the vendor and any implementation partner, holding them to scope and deadlines
Coordinate data migration from our current system with the vendor and internal data owners, including cleansing and testing
Run a clear project rhythm: steering updates to the Board, regular check-ins with brand stakeholders, and simple reporting

Lead the change (the most important part)

Map who is affected across each brand and what changes for them
Build and run a change and communications plan so nobody is surprised
Set up and lead a network of champions and super-users within each team
Organise training, user testing and go-live support, keeping disruption to the business to a minimum
Track adoption after go-live, gather feedback and fix what isn't working

Improve how we work

Document current recruitment and sales processes and find the friction
Redesign workflows so the new CRM supports how our best people actually work, not just how the old system did
Spot and drive quick wins in reporting, data quality and automation along the way
Leave behind clear process documentation and ownership once the project closes

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think and how you work with people than about years on a CV.

Essential

2–4 years in a project coordination, junior PM, PMO, business analyst, consulting or operations role
Some hands-on involvement in rolling out a system or process change, and seeing how people react to it
Highly organised: you can keep a plan, a vendor and a dozen stakeholders on track at once
Confident communicator who can explain things simply and hold your own with senior leaders
Curious about how work gets done, and driven to make it better
A strong academic record or clear evidence of being exceptionally sharp

Nice to have

Exposure to a CRM or ATS (Bullhorn, Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, Vincere or similar)
Experience in recruitment, staffing, professional services or consulting
Familiarity with change frameworks (e.g. Prosci ADKAR) or project methods (Agile, PRINCE2), or a willingness to learn them
Comfort with data: Excel, basic reporting, data cleansing

What's in it for you
Real ownership early in your career: this is your project, not a support role on someone else's
Board-level visibility and exposure to every brand in the business
A rare chance to redesign how a growing group works, and put your name to the result
A route into a longer-term operations, transformation or change role once the project lands

How to apply:
send your CV and a few lines on a change you've helped deliver (what worked, what you'd do differently)

jobs.description:
Company Name

PBS Systems

Job Location:

Calgary, AB (HQ)

Job Type

Full-time, Permanent

No. Of Openings

1

Job Requirement(s)

Travel within North America approx. 2 weeks per month

Internal Job Title

Project Manager – Tier 1

Reports To

Team Lead, Project Management

Compensation

$70,000 - $80,000 base salary; plus $5,000 - $15,000 in bonuses

PBS is the fastest growing “All Inclusive Business Platform” vendor in North America and we’ve only just begun!

PBS has been transforming how people buy and service cars for almost 40 years, becoming the third largest Dealership Management System (DMS) provider in North America. Each month, hundreds of new users join our platform, which helps dealerships manage sales, service, inventory, and accounting. What sets us apart is how we treat our customers - as partners, innovators and friends.

At PBS, we invest in your growth. Your career can progress in alignment with your strengths, interests, and aspirations. Apply today!

The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for leading and executing software conversion projects for PBS Systems’ automotive dealership clients. This role ensures successful project delivery by coordinating customer training, overseeing accurate data conversion, and managing seamless integration with third-party systems. Serving as the primary point of contact for clients, the Project Manager drives project planning, implementation, and communication across internal and external stakeholders. With a focus on customer satisfaction, data integrity, and system compatibility, this role requires up to 50% travel
to client sites to support successful adoption of PBS Systems software solutions.

Job Responsibilities

Lead and manage software conversion projects, including planning, organizing, and executing all implementation activities
Develop detailed implementation plans and timelines, ensuring milestones and deliverable are met
Coordinate and manage project resources, including personnel and equipment, to support a successful execution
Collaborate with customers and stakeholders to define project goals, scope, timeline, and resource needs
Oversee customer training programs on PBS software, ensuring materials are current, effective, and aligned with project objectives
Provide ongoing support and assistance to address any training-related issues
Monitor data conversion plans to transfer data from the customer’s existing software to PBS’s software
Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and security throughout the data conversion process
Troubleshoot and resolve any data-related issues
Establish and maintain integrations with third-party systems (ie. CRM platforms, DMS providers, and other software vendors)
Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless system integration and overall functionality
Maintain regular communication with dealership clients, internal teams, and other stakeholders, providing updates on project status, risks, and issues
Prepare and present weekly project progress reports, metrics, and other documentation
Identify and mitigate risks/issues that could arise during implementation
Identify and solve problems that arise during implementation
Document the implementation processes and procedures to facilitate future maintenance and support
Obtain 1 PBS Certification within the first year of employment

MUST HAVE Skills

1-3 years of experience working in a car dealership or the automotive industry
High school diploma
Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and project management processes, methodologies, and workflows
Strong computer skills are required, including proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel). The ability to quickly learn and adapt to new software tools is essential!
Ability to travel within Canada and the USA up to 2 weeks per month; valid passport, U.S. visa (if applicable), and full driver’s license are required

Additional Skills

PMI Certified Project Management Professional (PMP) is a strong asset
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly convey expectations and project information to internal and external stakeholders
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams by providing clear direction, motivation, and support
Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, timelines, and resources simultaneously
Adaptability to adjust plans and strategies as needed to keep projects on track
Ability to work collaboratively with team members, clients, and third-party vendors to achieve project goals

What We Offer

Professional Development – Continuous training, industry certifications, and clear pathways for career advancement.
Travel Opportunities - Travel to locations across Canada, the U.S., and the Caribbean
Comprehensive health benefits - Medical and dental coverage to support your well-being.
Paid Time Off – PTO to help you recharge and maintain work-life balance.
Inclusive culture - A collaborative, supportive team environment where your ideas and voice truly matter.
Employee recognition - Regular appreciation programs and performance-based incentives
Competitive compensation package
Competitive annual base salary
Up to $4,800 per year in product certification bonuses
Outstanding travel incentive bonuses
Additional performance incentives
Attractive employee referral bonuses

Staff discounts – Exclusive savings with partners such as GM, Dell, and more

Should you be selected for an interview, you will be contacted via email. Please monitor your junk/spam folder.

jobs.title: Project Manager II
jobs.description:
Unlock Your Career Potential: Project Management at ADP.
It's the machine that propels us forward with commitment and excellence. You are savvy about our business environment and know how to adeptly manage people and processes. You have the leadership and analytical skills to ensure projects reach the finish line -- on time, within scope and within budget. We give you the tools to succeed, with continuous opportunities to train and advance.

ADP is hiring a
Project Manager II (in Miami only)
. In this position, you'll be responsible for the successful planning, coordination, and implementation of projects within My Life Advisor to ensure business goals and objectives are accomplished within designated timeframes and budgets.

We strive for every interaction to be driven by our CORE
values: Insightful Expertise, Integrity is Everything, Service Excellence, Inspiring Innovation, Each Person Counts, Results-Driven, and Social Responsibility.

Basic Function

Responsible for the successful deployment of enhanced or new ADP products on time and with high quality utilizing Project Manager Standards aligned with the PMP or other professional standards. Responsible for organizational alignment across all functional areas (Development, Implementation, Service, Training, Marketing, Sales, Etc.). Responsible for forming the project team and monitoring their activities. Ensures milestones are successfully met through the management of project activities, tasks and coordination of resources. Responsible for directing Pilot and Rollout activities to assure quality and HRO acceptance.

Essential Responsibilities

Project manages the deployment of new ADP products and subsequent product versions and releases. Manages a project team from all TotalSource functional areas (Implementation, Service, Training, Documentation, Marketing, and Sales) to assure organizational readiness. Manages the project's scope (requirements and quality), develops and manages the overall project plan and monitors changes. May revise estimates and milestone dates in response to a change in scope during the project. Communicates and gains approval from Sr. Management for all changes that have measurable impact to the project plan.
Coordinates and communicates with the Regions through Product Champions that are assigned by each Region. Assures that Sales is receiving communications through Marketing. Communicates with Sr. Management as appropriate.
Identify all risks to the scope, quality and schedule. Develops options and strategies to mitigate risk and keep the project on schedule with high quality. Documents these risks and mitigating strategies and publishes them to project team members and Sr. Management.
Clarifies organizational priorities from the Project Sponsor in terms of Scope (Features/Functionality required), quality levels (acceptable or desirable) and schedule. Manages the project and makes decisions according to these overall priorities
Develops and communicates the project plan tasks through MS Project, Excel, or other agreed upon tools and assigns tasks to the appropriate team member. Tracks team members on project task execution and escalates when members miss or believe they will miss significant plan milestones.
Facilitates regular project team meetings. Receives regular updates from all team members. Tracks all issues on an issue log and assures that all issues are resolved. Escalates when necessary. Conducts side meetings and working session, as needed, to resolve issues.
Defines the QA, Field Test and/or Pilot strategy to assure the desired quality and reduce risk to clients (internal or external). Defines QA, Field Test and Pilot resources and assures that appropriate resources are assigned. Recruits Pilot regions and clients and makes sure that clients sign a Pilot agreement. Monitors quality at every stage to make sure that significant issues are resolved timely.
Assists Product Manager in defining the rollout strategy and schedule. Assists with facilitating on site or Webinar Management Overviews to assure that all Regions and other appropriate organizations are ready to sell, train, implement and support the enhanced or new release. Continues to formally and informally communicate with the Region and Division for several months after rollout and other areas after rollout to get additional feedback form the regions and the clients to enhance the deliverable.
Continues to manage future project phases and releases as needed.
Performs Business Analysts duties as required

Scope/ Complexity

Proven ability to successfully lead projects, as assigned.

Decision Making /Judgement

Receives minimum supervision with the ability to work independently within established parameters. Generally works under deadlines and subject to heavy workloads.

Accountability

Errors, bad judgment, team leadership, and project delays can cause delay, expense and disruption to project(s) status.

Travel Requirements

Regional, Client, and Satellite Office Travel (overnight): twice a year to other ADP locations

Competencies

Results Oriented: Takes personal ownership for achieving the highest levels of personal and organizational performance in order to help the overall business achieve their goals (Sales, Revenue, Starts, NOI, Expense, Retention - Quality). Accountable for meeting project schedule, achieving quality goals, and assuring organizational alignment.
Approach to Work: Willing and able to take on diverse projects and tasks, as assigned, that are priorities for the business. Displays energy and initiative. Takes ownership for defining priorities and utilizing project resources. Accepts feedback professionally and constructively.
Collaboration/Teamwork: Works effectively with project team that is outside the formal line of authority to meet project objectives.
Client Focus: Understands the perspective of the client and takes actions to integrate their needs with the products and strategic direction of ADP. Works closely with Marketing, the Regions, and directly with clients to get continuous feedback.
Detail orientation: Tracks and documents all project open items and tasks. Follows up to assure on time completion by the assigned resources. Conducts working sessions and meetings, as necessary, to address larger cross functional issues.
Follows Project Management disciplines in the following areas: Scope Management, Schedule Management, Cost Management, Issue Management, Risk Management, Quality Management, and Communication Management.
Project Management/Planning: Establishes and manages project plan. Accomplishes project requirements by monitoring results, controlling resources and modifying project plan. Overcomes unforeseen obstacles/barriers. Anticipates resource needs, identifies and tracks detailed tasks, sets priorities, defines dependencies, and schedules activities. Conducts regular Project Meetings to track progress.
Building/Managing Teams: Organizes, gains the involvement of, and manages project teams from all functional areas to accomplish specific project and organizational goals. Monitors team activities and escalates issues, where needed, to maximize department results. Uses excellent verbal and written skills to maintain plans and issues logs.
Problem Analysis/Resolution: Gathers information on issues to construct options and either make decisions or recommend options to Sr. Mgmt, as appropriate. Anticipates, identifies, and resolves problems in a timely manner. Assigns tasks to appropriate cross functional resources and follows up.
Works well under pressure and has a high tolerance for stress. Must possess excellent organizational and time management skills for managing multiple, diverse and conflicting activities. Must possess excellent communication, presentation and facilitation skills.

Required Qualifications

Minimum of 3-5 years of Project Management experience
1-2 years of experience in progressive structured analysis
Expertise with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project and Visio
Experience with project management tools and structured methodologies
Excellent organizational, planning and time management skills for handling multiple and conflicting activities
Ability to think independently and make decisions
Strong presentation and communication skills to support Senior Leadership

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Preference will be given to candidates who have the following:

Good working knowledge of Project Management software a plus
PMP or equivalent professional project management certification preferred
Knowledge of functional area and related company products
Capacity for building relationships both internally and externally
Strong focus on client service
Capacity to effectively manage a team

Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Matched Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short-and Long-Term Disability, Charitable Contribution Match, Holidays, Personal Days & Vacation, Paid Volunteer Time Off, and more. The compensation for this role is USD $86,600.00 - USD $161,600.00 / Year*

Actual compensation will not be less than the applicable minimum wage or minimum exempt salary requirement under federal, state and local laws.

A little about ADP:
We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating a down-to-earth culture that embraces our core values, welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition for our work by many esteemed organizations, learn more at ADP Awards and Recognition.

Hiring decisions are based upon ADP’s operating needs, and applicant merit including, but not limited to, qualifications, experience, ability, availability, cooperation, and job performance.

ADP has a long, proud history of conducting business with the highest ethical standards and full compliance with all applicable laws. Overview

The Payment Systems Business Analyst is responsible for supporting the continuous improvement and effective operation of GreenState's payment systems and related business processes. By partnering with business and technical stakeholders, this role helps deliver payment solutions that improve efficiency, strengthen controls, support compliance requirements, and enhance the member experience. This position analyzes business needs, facilitates solution development, supports system changes, and provides insight into process and operational performance. Success in this role is measured by the quality of business requirements, effectiveness of implemented solutions, operational improvements realized, and the ability to support reliable, scalable payment services across the organization.

At GreenState, our purpose is to create lasting value for our members, our communities, and one another. We empower our teams to create opportunities that strengthen financial well-being, transform lives, and enhance the vitality of the communities we serve. We know our success—now and in the future—is deeply rooted in fostering an engaging, diverse, and inclusive workplace where everyone knows they matter, their work makes an impact, and their everyday commitment to living our values is what brings our mission to life.  

Salary range for this position is $79,173.90 - $92,563.38 with a progressive benefit package. 

Responsibilities

Performs essential duties and responsibilities in the following areas which may include but are not limited to those listed and are subject to change. Adheres to the Credit Union's core values and Service Standards in conducting GreenState's mission and vision.
Demonstrates a positive member service (internal and external) focus at all times.
Demonstrates teamwork in all interactions with coworkers and in the completion of all duties and responsibilities.
Ensures confidentiality of member information.
Supports a diverse and inclusive work environment.

Facilitate the translation of business requirements into clear, actionable documentation that supports system enhancements, process improvements, and operational efficiencies.
Support the successful implementation of payment system changes by participating in solution design, testing, validation, and deployment activities to ensure business requirements are met.
Analyze payment processes, operational workflows, system performance, and transaction activity to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
Contribute to the ongoing effectiveness and reliability of payment services by helping resolve operational issues, researching root causes, and recommending practical business solutions.
Maintain accurate and current business documentation, including requirements, workflows, procedures, testing artifacts, and controls that support operational consistency, knowledge transfer, and audit readiness.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to support payment-related initiatives, ensuring alignment, communication, and coordination throughout the change lifecycle.
Develop and deliver reporting, analysis, and insights that support informed decision-making, operational effectiveness, and service improvement opportunities.
Support compliance, risk management, and control objectives by evaluating the operational impact of proposed changes and ensuring adherence to established policies and procedures.
Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance payment processes, strengthen controls, improve efficiency, and elevate the member and employee experience.
Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Systems, Accounting, Operations, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
3-5 years of experience supporting business analysis, systems analysis, payment operations, process improvement, financial services operations, or a related discipline.
Experience in a financial institution, payments organization, fintech company, or credit union environment, preferred.
Demonstrated ability to analyze business needs, document requirements, evaluate processes, and recommend solutions that improve operational effectiveness and service delivery.
Working knowledge of payment systems, financial services operations, or transaction processing environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills with the ability to independently manage routine and moderately complex assignments and appropriately escalate higher-risk issues.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business, operational, technical, and vendor teams.
Ability to support system enhancements and process improvements through testing, validation, implementation, and documentation activities.
Proficiency with business technology, reporting, and Microsoft Office tools used to analyze information, support decision-making, and document business processes.
Must be bondable.

Reporting Relationship

This position reports to VP Accounting & Payment Services.

This position is not responsible for the supervision of others.

jobs.title: TPO Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a TPO Business Analyst to join our TPO Business Strategy team to serve as the analytical engine connecting product development, operations, and enterprise partner feedback. This role will own product and process gap analysis — identifying where our TPO platform falls short against enterprise partner needs, investor requirements, and operational best practices — and translate those findings into actionable requirements for engineering and process improvements for operations. The ideal candidate will have experience in solar finance, business analysis, or operations and will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets, and Risk teams.  

This position will be based out of San Francisco, CA or Santa Clara, CA with an in-office schedule set at the direct manager’s discretion in accordance with the company policies and procedures. 

Responsibilities

Conduct end-to-end product and process gap analyses by mapping the TPO customer journey (sale creation through asset onboarding), identifying structural gaps, and categorizing them by severity and business impact — similar in scope to internal initiatives like Project Clarity.  
Translate voice-of-customer feedback from enterprise installer partners and investor/capital markets stakeholders into structured product requirements and operational process change proposals for Engineering and Operations teams.  
Own change order and milestone enforcement analysis — evaluate current process controls (e.g., CO enforcement at NTP, M2 as-built verification, Year 1 kWh reconciliation), identify attack vectors and failure modes, and design minimum viable fixes that require no or minimal engineering development.  
Build detailed gap analysis deliverables (Word docs, Excel models, process flow diagrams) that clearly articulate current state vs. target state, root cause, and prioritized remediation paths with implementation timelines. 
Partner with the Operations team to redesign operational process flows when gaps are identified — drafting new SOPs, updating milestone checklists, and coordinating rollout across QSS and internal ops stakeholders.  
Support product development prioritization by maintaining a living backlog of product gaps mapped to partner impact, investor risk, and revenue exposure — enabling data-driven sprint planning conversations with Engineering.  
Analyze PI (Partner Installer) behavior patterns using Salesforce data to identify systemic risks such as production overstatement, CO circumvention, and documentation non-compliance, and recommend systemic controls.  
Participate in cross-functional project meetings (e.g., CLS issue mapping, PMO-led initiatives) and produce structured meeting notes, action item trackers, and follow-up deliverables.   

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, data analytics, or a related field with a minimum of 5+ years of professional work experience in business analysis, operations analysis, management consulting, or strategy/operations role in solar finance, fintech, or financial services. 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to map complex multi-step processes, identify failure points, and propose structured solutions — comfort with process flow mapping and root cause analysis. 
Proficiency in Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (structured presentations for leadership audiences). 
Excellent written communication — ability to produce clear, structured gap analysis documents, SOPs, and requirements specifications. 
Comfort working across multiple teams simultaneously (Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets) in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in residential solar TPO operations, loan servicing, or asset management — familiarity with milestone-based workflows (NTP, M1, M2, M3). 
Familiarity with Salesforce as a system of record and experience pulling operational data for analysis. 
Exposure to investor reporting, capital markets due diligence, or portfolio quality analysis in a renewable energy or structured finance context. 
Experience with process improvement frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma) or project management tools (Jira, Asana, Miro).

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Pre-emptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions, giving organisations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do.

Securin delivers penetration testing, vulnerability management and offensive research for enterprises, critical infrastructure operators and public-sector clients. It is investing heavily in AI-augmented zero-day discovery and autonomous offensive testing.

Job Summary:

OT / ICS Penetration Testing:

▪ Plan and execute safety-first penetration tests of OT/ICS environments (water and wastewater, energy, manufacturing, building systems), including passive asset discovery, Purdue-model segmentation testing and IT-to-OT pivot analysis.
▪ Assess PLCs, RTUs, HMIs, SCADA servers, historians and engineering workstations across major vendors (e.g., Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider Electric) and SCADA platforms (e.g., VTScada, Ignition, AVEVA/Wonderware).
▪ Test industrial protocols such as Modbus/TCP, DNP3, EtherNet/IP/CIP, S7comm, OPC UA, BACnet and IEC 60870-5-104/61850 for authentication, integrity and logic-manipulation weaknesses.
▪ Build and use lab or digital-twin replicas to validate attack paths before touching production; operate strictly within client-approved rules of engagement, change windows and safety constraints.
▪ Map findings to ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS, with remediation guidance that is realistic for plant operations.

Exploit Development & Zero-Day Discovery:

▪ Conduct vulnerability research on binaries, firmware, embedded/IoT devices, web applications and enterprise software using reverse engineering, source code review and fuzzing (coverage-guided, protocol-aware and grammar-based).
▪ Write reliable proof-of-concept and weaponized exploits for memory corruption (stack/heap overflows, use-after-free, type confusion), logic flaws and authentication bypasses, including bypass of modern mitigations (ASLR, DEP/NX, CFG, stack canaries).
▪ Perform n-day analysis and patch diffing to rapidly validate exploitability of newly disclosed CVEs for clients and for Securin’s exposure intelligence.
▪ Apply AI-augmented techniques, such as LLM-assisted code review, agent-driven fuzz harness generation and automated crash triage, to scale discovery within Securin’s Zero Day program.
▪ Run coordinated vulnerability disclosure with vendors, CERTs and CNAs, and author technical advisories and research publications.

AI & Agentic System Pentesting:

▪ Assess LLM applications, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents and tool integrations (including MCP servers and plugins) for direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive data disclosure, excessive agency, insecure output handling, tool abuse and supply-chain weaknesses.
▪ Test against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP agentic AI threat guidance, MITRE ATLAS and the NIST AI RMF, and translate results into concrete architectural fixes.
▪ Build and operate automated adversarial testing harnesses (e.g., PyRIT, garak, promptfoo) and custom attack agents for repeatable AI red teaming.
▪ Contribute offensive techniques and agent workflows to Securin’s AI-driven offensive security platform and autonomous pentesting research.

Core Delivery & Team Contribution:

▪ Conduct network, web application, API, cloud and red team engagements, emulating real-world adversaries using the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
▪ Develop and execute detailed test plans and methodologies; manage engagement timelines, deadlines and client expectations.
▪ Prepare high-quality reports using Securin templates and present findings to technical and executive stakeholders in kick-off calls and readouts.
▪ Advise developers, system administrators and OT engineers on secure configuration, coding best practices and remediation.
▪ Mentor analysts, contribute to internal training, methodology and tooling, and help shape report deliverables.

Requirements:

▪ Minimum 2-5 years of hands-on penetration testing and offensive security experience, including significant depth in at least two of: OT/ICS security, exploit development/vulnerability research, and AI/LLM security.
▪ Demonstrated OT/ICS penetration testing experience on real industrial environments or high-fidelity labs, with a strong grasp of safety-first testing practices.
▪ Proven exploit-writing ability, evidenced by original vulnerability research: CVE credits, published advisories or exploits, conference talks, or high-level bug bounty/CTF results.
▪ Hands-on experience testing LLM applications or agentic AI systems, with a working understanding of how models, retrieval, tools and permissions combine to create attack surface.
▪ Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++, and working knowledge of x86/x64 and ARM assembly; Bash/PowerShell required; Rust or Go a plus.
▪ Proficiency with reverse engineering and debugging tools (IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, WinDbg, GDB with pwndbg/GEF), fuzzers (AFL++, libFuzzer, boofuzz) and offensive tooling (Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Wireshark with ICS dissectors, C2 frameworks such as Cobalt Strike or Sliver).
▪ Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks including OWASP Top 10, CVE/CWE, OSSTMM, NIST, MITRE ATT&CK, ISA/IEC 62443 and MITRE ATLAS.
▪ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electrical/Control Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
▪ Excellent written and spoken English; able to convey complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
▪ Based in Europe and eligible to work through EPAM; able to overlap with US business hours for client meetings, and available for occasional travel (e.g., on-site OT assessments) when required.

Preferred Certifications:

Certifications are a plus, not a substitute for demonstrated skill. Public research, CVEs and exploits carry equal or greater weight.

Preferred certifications / evidence

Exploit development & offensive

OSCP, OSEP, OSED, OSWE, OSEE, OSCE³, GIAC GXPN, CRTO, CRTP/CRTE, HTB certifications

OT / ICS security

GIAC GICSP, GRID or GCIP; ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Specialist/Expert; SANS ICS410/ICS515/ICS612 training

AI / LLM security

AI red teaming certifications or training (e.g., HTB AI Red Teamer path, C-AI/MLPen), or published AI security research

Research track record

CVE credits, vendor advisories, Pwn2Own/DEF CON-level CTF results, bug bounty rankings, conference talks

Building with AI: What We Expect:

Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works: not as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations and how our expertise compounds over time. Everyone is expected to integrate GenAI tools into daily workflows, understand their limitations, follow data classification rules, and move beyond using GenAI to building with it. For this role in particular, we expect you to:
▪ Use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) daily for research, code generation, analysis and reporting, and validate AI-generated output before acting on it.
▪ Design and build multi-step AI agents for offensive tasks with human-in-the-loop validation and sandboxed execution.
▪ Apply AI security fundamentals (prompt injection risk, data classification, responsible handling of client data) in your own workflows, not just in client tests.
▪ Connect GenAI tools to internal data sources and APIs, and contribute reusable skills, templates and agent configurations to Securin’s shared repository.
▪ Participate in AI adoption sprints, hackathons and knowledge-sharing within the team.

jobs.description:
Bristol or London

About Us

Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.

We provide a wide range of engineering and consultancy services, including acoustics, air quality, building services (MEP), fire, lighting, security and sustainability to name but a few. Together, our highly skilled teams use technical expertise and problem-solving skills to bring buildings to life. We ensure that whatever the building, its design is outstanding, and its operations meet the needs of the communities it serves.

We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

About The Role

Our multi-disciplinary software, product, and data team serves as a central hub of digital expertise and innovation, supporting projects across the company. We work collaboratively with engineers, consultants and other specialists to use data and technology to solve real-world problems and improve the services we provide to our clients.

We have an opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist to play a key role in using data, analytics, statistical methods and data science to generate insight, support decision-making and improve our engineering services.

This is a broad analytical role. You will work across the full lifecycle of a problem: understanding stakeholder needs, exploring and assessing data, identifying appropriate analytical approaches, communicating findings and, where appropriate, developing statistical or machine-learning models or client-ready insights/tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and has a critical eye for finding the right solution for the problem. Sometimes this may be exploratory analysis, a dashboard or a set of clearly defined metrics; in other cases, it may involve forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning or building/working with AI.

It's an exciting time to join our Digital team. Working alongside a range of specialist engineers and consultants, you will be joining a collaborative, knowledgeable, highly engaged team, and offer a supportive, flexible, and high-performing work culture. In a time where building and energy resilience is ever more important, we are driving forward innovation to make an impact with data and technology.

You will have the opportunity to engage in a variety of high-impact projects, working on challenging problems for some of the UK’s most notable organisations, including the NHS and Oxford University. Our team has recently worked on creating data science-led for managing estates in hospitals, building energy forecasting models, and harnessing data on building performance to create better designed buildings of the future.

In this key and varied role, you can expect to:

Work with engineers, consultants, product teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate sometimes ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical problems.
Develop and implement data-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems across the company.
Use SQL, Python and other analytical tools to investigate datasets, identify trends and relationships, test hypotheses and generate actionable insights.
Apply appropriate statistical techniques, forecasting methods, ML and AI approaches where they add value to the problem being solved.
Collaborate with the product and software engineering teams to turn analytical work into reusable tools, workflows and data-driven products where appropriate.
Develop reproducible and maintainable analytical code, following best practices, including version control, testing, and peer reviews.
Contribute to the development of analytical and data science capability across the business by sharing approaches, reusable methods and good practice

About You

To be successful in this role you’ll need:

Essential Skills

Experience applying data and analysis to real-world business, engineering or operational problems.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an initially ambiguous question and determine an appropriate analytical approach.
Ability to work on projects independently and own deliverables.
Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, visualisation and data science (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL). Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, unit testing, code review, etc.).
Strong experience with data visualisation frameworks (e.g., PowerBI, Streamlit).
Experience applying machine learning and AI, including generative AI, to real-world problems where it provides clear benefit.
Familiarity with statistical concepts and their application in data analysis.
Solid communication skills, capable of effectively engaging with and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI and other relevant standards.

Desirable Skills

Knowledge of the engineering industry and its challenges.
Experience with one of the major machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Knowledge of mathematical optimisation methods, such as linear, integer or constraint optimisation, and associated tools (e.g. OR-Tools).
Experience with MS Fabric or equivalent data warehousing solution.
Experience working in a cloud computing environment.
Familiarity with containerisation and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

For candidates joining at Senior
level, we would additionally expect you to lead more complex or ambiguous analytical projects, shape analytical approaches and overarching priorities, work independently with senior stakeholders, review and support the work of others, and help raise analytical standards across the team.

How To Apply

To apply simply complete a CV profile and submit your application.

If shortlisted, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to arrange an introductory call (about 30 minutes) to discuss the role and your experience in more detail. From there, successful candidates will be invited to attend a panel interview, either via Microsoft Teams or in person at one of our offices. We aim to provide feedback at each stage of the process.

Adjustments and accommodations

If there are adjustments or accommodations that we can put in place to help you participate and give your best at any stage of the recruitment process (whether relating to disability, neurodivergence or anything else) please let us know.

Data privacy

We have updated our terms and conditions for candidates, click here to find out more.

Recruitment agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners who assist us when required. We do not acknowledge speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

jobs.description:
Description

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a TPO Business Analyst to join our TPO Business Strategy team to serve as the analytical engine connecting product development, operations, and enterprise partner feedback. This role will own product and process gap analysis — identifying where our TPO platform falls short against enterprise partner needs, investor requirements, and operational best practices — and translate those findings into actionable requirements for engineering and process improvements for operations. The ideal candidate will have experience in solar finance, business analysis, or operations and will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets, and Risk teams.  

This position will be based out of San Francisco, CA or Santa Clara, CA with an in-office schedule set at the direct manager’s discretion in accordance with the company policies and procedures. 

Responsibilities

Conduct end-to-end product and process gap analyses by mapping the TPO customer journey (sale creation through asset onboarding), identifying structural gaps, and categorizing them by severity and business impact — similar in scope to internal initiatives like Project Clarity.  
Translate voice-of-customer feedback from enterprise installer partners and investor/capital markets stakeholders into structured product requirements and operational process change proposals for Engineering and Operations teams.  
Own change order and milestone enforcement analysis — evaluate current process controls (e.g., CO enforcement at NTP, M2 as-built verification, Year 1 kWh reconciliation), identify attack vectors and failure modes, and design minimum viable fixes that require no or minimal engineering development.  
Build detailed gap analysis deliverables (Word docs, Excel models, process flow diagrams) that clearly articulate current state vs. target state, root cause, and prioritized remediation paths with implementation timelines. 
Partner with the Operations team to redesign operational process flows when gaps are identified — drafting new SOPs, updating milestone checklists, and coordinating rollout across QSS and internal ops stakeholders.  
Support product development prioritization by maintaining a living backlog of product gaps mapped to partner impact, investor risk, and revenue exposure — enabling data-driven sprint planning conversations with Engineering.  
Analyze PI (Partner Installer) behavior patterns using Salesforce data to identify systemic risks such as production overstatement, CO circumvention, and documentation non-compliance, and recommend systemic controls.  
Participate in cross-functional project meetings (e.g., CLS issue mapping, PMO-led initiatives) and produce structured meeting notes, action item trackers, and follow-up deliverables.   

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, data analytics, or a related field with a minimum of 5+ years of professional work experience in business analysis, operations analysis, management consulting, or strategy/operations role in solar finance, fintech, or financial services. 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to map complex multi-step processes, identify failure points, and propose structured solutions — comfort with process flow mapping and root cause analysis. 
Proficiency in Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (structured presentations for leadership audiences). 
Excellent written communication — ability to produce clear, structured gap analysis documents, SOPs, and requirements specifications. 
Comfort working across multiple teams simultaneously (Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets) in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in residential solar TPO operations, loan servicing, or asset management — familiarity with milestone-based workflows (NTP, M1, M2, M3). 
Familiarity with Salesforce as a system of record and experience pulling operational data for analysis. 
Exposure to investor reporting, capital markets due diligence, or portfolio quality analysis in a renewable energy or structured finance context. 
Experience with process improvement frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma) or project management tools (Jira, Asana, Miro). 
SQL or BI tool experience (Tableau, Looker) for operational data analysis is a plus.

We’re seeking a dynamic and experienced Project Manager to join Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation (NASO). A successful candidate will assume a critical role in overseeing and leading engineering and technical services to support maintenance and planning for the overhaul and repair equipment and systems associated with U.S. Navy Surface Ships. This position will be located in Pearl Harbor, HI.

This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain your DoD Secret level clearance.

Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation is part of our high-performing Maritime, Engineering, Technology, and Sustainment Business Unit which provides critical services to nearly all U.S. Navy surface ships, submarines and craft and is achieving truly impactful outcomes. Serco has over 9,000 people in North America, with operations across the U.S. and Canada. Lead teams providing technical guidance to Ship's Force relating to work on Hull, Mechanical & Electrical (HM&E) and aviation equipment and systems which interface with combat support systems, and hull support items such as damage control equipment for flooding and fire, climate control/ventilation systems, tank and voids, plenums, etc., habitability improvements, and piping systems. Also encompassed are electrical generation, power and distribution systems including controllers, junction boxes, cabling, and cableways.
Lead the performance of inspections, examinations, analysis, repairs incidental to such and make recommendations in the areas of maintenance planning and/or repair as requested on naval propulsion and auxiliary machinery associated with high pressure steam propulsion plants and U.S. Naval Surface Force Ship propulsion plants and auxiliaries.
Liaison with ship’s reactor department is required prior to accomplishing inspections, testing, and production work
Manage teams performing, assisting, or providing technical guidance on the performance of fault identification and support Ship's Force with physical repairs of the types of naval propulsion and auxiliary and aviation/flight deck equipment/combat systems and systems set forth herein
Responsible for technical support and advice to Ship's Force pertinent to the operation, overhaul, and repair of specific items of, auxiliary machinery, electrical, and hull support and aviation systems as directed by the appropriate technical authority.

Perform or provide technical guidance in support of TYCOM Cableway Improvement Program (CIP) in accordance with NAVSEAINST 9304 series to Ship's Force with training, inspection, repair assistance and reporting.

Cultivating positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical and damage control systems for U.S. Naval Ships.
Two years of supervisory experience.

Knowledge of best practice maritime processes and support methodologies to meet Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) requirements.
Ability to lead and manage large teams.
Ability to operate personal computers and have good knowledge and operational abilities with Microsoft Office tools.
